name: Pending Manual Changes
description: Sent to source owners when an account change is needed on a source that requires manual provisioning.
subject: Manual changes required for $identityDisplayName
body:
Manual Changes Required

$launcher has requested the following account changes for $identityDisplayName. These changes require manual provisioning by you.

#if ( $approvalSet.items ) #foreach ($item in $approvalSet.items)

Source: $item.applicationName

#if ( $item.nativeIdentity )

Account: $item.nativeIdentity

#end #if ( $item.instance )

Instance: $item.instance

#end

Operation: $item.operation

#if ( $item.displayName )

Attribute: $item.displayName

#elseif ( $item.name )

Attribute: $item.name

#end #if ( $item.displayValue )

Value(s): $item.displayValue

#elseif ( $item.csv )

Value(s): $item.csv

#end #if ( $item.requesterComments )

Requester comments: $item.requesterComments

#end
#end #end

Thank you for your prompt attention.
SailPoint Identity Security Cloud
